current.text: Minnesota lost Naz Reid and Julius Randle. Jonathan Kuminga, a poor rebounder, has arrived. Joan Beringer is the only backup center and may not be ready.
The team is short on size and defensive rebounding, and the bench is thin.
He should have to do more this season. Beringer not being ready could mean extra minutes for him.
He is one of four set starters, with LaMelo Ball, Anthony Edwards and Jaden McDaniels.
LaMelo Ball throwing lobs to him is a plus, and his usage could go up slightly with Ball on the team.
He will have to cover on defense for Kuminga and Ball, who are poor defenders.
He is 34 and eligible for a contract extension.
He could be traded if the season goes badly.

Experts disagree on his price. One calls an ADP in the 70s undervalued compared with Clingan and Kessler and expects double-digit rebounds, two blocks and 60%+ FG with only small age-related declines. Another says 70 to 72 is too high because, past 30, he may lose blocks, FG% and usage.
He has a tight range in round six: best case 59th, worst case 116th.
The newest call says he is a points league target, and less of one in category leagues.
Minnesota has a two-game week in the matchup starting March 15. That is week 20 of our fantasy playoffs.
Minnesota should be competitive and is not expected to rest players to tank. One expert predicts 53 wins.

durable.text: His strong categories are rebounds, blocks and FG%. All three are league outliers, and he averaged 11.5 rebounds last season.
He is a big FT% liability. He shot 52.6% from the line last season, the second-worst FT impact in the league.
For managers punting FT%, his poor free throw shooting barely matters.
He does not shoot from outside and makes no threes.
He is an elite defender (a walking top 10 defense), a great screener and offensive rebounder, and durable.

note: Gobert is a three-category center (REB, BLK, FG%) with a severe FT% hole and no threes. He fits punt FT builds, including Giannis builds, and costs very little (Yahoo average cost 7.2 USD, ESPN 4.7 USD, 10 USD in our league last season), so 8 to 11 USD is fair. Early in the season, check whether his blocks and FG% hold at age 34, and whether Beringer's absence gives him more minutes. Remember Minnesota's two-game week in our week 20.
